text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: A run unworthy of the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It seems I have shown everyone
such an embarrassing display.
choice_data_list: Then there's only one thing to do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how reassuring of you to say~.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall work even harder than before,
so please do stay by my side, alright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Accept the truth and make the most of it next time.
It means I've been given that opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "If I falter here... it would truly bring shame to the Mejiro name."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall do my best,
with a "Hup, hup!"~
